free_tier.stated: The cheapest large machine found among evaluated providers: 4 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM, 50 GB system disk, 50 Mbps with a 1 TB monthly cap that falls to 10 Mbps once reached, at CNY 99 a year, quoted as 4C4G 50G 50Mps 99元/年. The vendor sells it as a student offer restricted to ages 18 to 25.

chaining: With a mainland identity and a filed domain, this is 4 cores and 4 GiB for the price of two coffees a year; without them it is unreachable, which is the whole finding.

limits.value: The 1 TB monthly transfer is the first thing to bind: past it the port drops to 10 Mbps rather than stopping, so a 500 GB day of transfer takes about 111 hours at the throttled rate. The student offer also carries no 24-hour refund.
